channel.title: Lemmuel Turaya — Portfolio Changelog
channel.description: Versioned log of what ships on lemmuel-turaya / kon2raya portfolio — features, fixes, and content updates.

item.title: v4.4 — Fourth case study published: Enterprise HRIS
item.description: Enterprise HRIS (client under NDA) is live as the fourth published case study. Modern stack: Laravel 12 + Sanctum + TOTP 2FA (Google2FA + bacon-qr-code) on the API; Vue 3 + Vite + Pinia + TypeScript + Vuestic Admin on the UI. ~54 models, ~41 controllers, ~57 migrations, ~95 Vue pages across 30 domain folders. Full HR lifecycle — employees, OUs, time & attendance, leave, payroll (with DomPDF payslips), memos with concurrency-safe numbering via GET_LOCK, performance evaluations, OU-scoped RBAC, Storybook + Playwright, dual CI/CD (Jenkins + Buddy). Hero stat bumped from "3 case studies" to "4".

item.title: v4.8 — Two more case studies: LLM-Friendly Wiki + WMS v2 Inventory Rewrite
item.description: Two more case studies, hero stat bumped 6 → 8. (1) LLM-Friendly Wiki — a hand-maintained Obsidian Markdown vault with YAML frontmatter (source_paths, related, last_verified) inspired by Karpathy's thesis that the best AI-coding artifact is a well-structured wiki of your own code. Per-folder _INDEX.md pattern, same-turn updates as the rule, Decisions/Runbooks/Examples sub-vaults. (2) WMS v2 — active rewrite of a legacy enterprise warehouse + inventory system onto Laravel 12 + Vue 3 with a canonical V3DataTable + BaseCrud pattern, ModuleSchemaInterface, CI-enforced guardrails (ESLint + PHPStan + migration linter), online schema migrations (ALGORITHM=INPLACE LOCK=NONE), parity-first rollout. ~103 models, ~76 controllers, ~121 migrations, ~130 pages. Karpathy coding guidelines bundled into the agent guide.

item.title: v4.7 — Two new case studies: Transport Mgmt System + Autonomous AI Engineer
item.description: Added two new case studies, pushing the proof shelf from 4 to 6. (1) Transport Management System on Vue 3 + Laravel 11 — ~68 models, ~99 controllers, ~98 migrations, ~324 Vue pages, live GPS, Spatie Permissions, full booking → dispatch → costing → invoice lifecycle. (2) Autonomous AI Engineer — a multi-LLM agent pipeline (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Qwen) wired into a production ticketing system. `php artisan ai:work {ref}` picks up ASSIGNED tickets, auto-detects the target repo from a systems table, runs the work via AiHarnessService, persists per-ticket chat memory, and an independent verifier (`ai:verify`) runs the real PHPUnit test suite before any merge. Every action logged to the ticket comment thread. Mock screenshots + OG images generated.

item.title: v4.6 — Anonymized mock screenshots wired into every case study
item.description: Generated four anonymized mock screenshots (1600×900) — one per case study — that mirror the real production UI without leaking client data: Real-Estate Developer Portal commission releases dashboard (10 anonymized rows with tier chips + status pills + approver columns), Brokerage Commission share- distribution view (4-step approver stepper + 5 summary tiles + per-tier shares), WMS mobile picking screen on a phone-frame mock (scan input, Bluetooth-paired Epson printer indicator, recent scans, Print + Confirm), and Enterprise HRIS payroll period (6 summary tiles, payroll record table with 2FA badges, multi-OU scoping). Each shot has a clear "MOCK" tag in its caption.

item.title: v4.5 — All client names made confidential
item.description: All four case studies now anonymize the client (under NDA framing). Titles are generic ("Real-Estate Developer Portal", "Brokerage Commission System", "WMS Mobile App", "Enterprise HRIS"). Tagline + meta + body + OG images regenerated. GitHub repo links on the user's own personal GitHub are kept as proof of work.

item.title: v4.3 — Real-Estate Developer Portal case study polished from real codebase
item.description: Pulled real numbers from the local working dirs of a Laravel 11 + Vue 3 (Velzon) developer-portal client (under NDA). Reframed it as a real-estate *developer* operations platform — not a brokerage — covering the full reservation → sales → equity → amortization → in-house financing → commission → collection lifecycle. ~65 models, ~67 controllers, ~99 migrations, ~102 Vue views, AG Grid Enterprise, JWT auth, CASL RBAC, OU scoping, 5-tier seller hierarchy.

item.title: v4.2 — WMS Mobile App case study polished from real project files
item.description: Pulled real metrics from the local Flutter app, Laravel backend, and Nuxt admin of a logistics-enterprise client (under NDA) to enrich the WMS writeup: 13 feature modules, three picking generations (base / enhanced / v3), Bluetooth ESC/POS label printing on Epson TM-P80II, dual-input scanning (camera + keyboard-wedge), Cloudflare Turnstile re-auth, 108 build releases, ~251 Eloquent models, ~103 controllers, ~315 migrations on the API.

item.title: v4.1 — Third case study published: Brokerage Commission System
item.description: Brokerage Commission System (client under NDA) is now live as the third published case study. A full-stack real-estate brokerage operations platform on Vue + Laravel — commission engine with multi-tier shares + approver workflow, multi-OU RBAC, sales pipeline, expenses, HR-lite. ~22 months of iteration, 52 Eloquent models, ~100 migrations, ~640 commits across the api + ui repos. Hero stat bumped from "2 case studies" to "3".

item.title: v4.0 — Round 2: polish, proof, performance
item.description: Round 2 of the employer-attention pass. Wired up the work-filter chips (data-tags driven, persisted in localStorage), swapped the "Coffee Cups ∞" hero stat for "Case Studies", added the "last shipped" footer stamp pulled from document.lastModified, scaffolded the third case study (jbc-commission-system) with its own OG card. Dropped image weight by ~3.4 MB (logo, mylogo orphan deleted, cover photo re-encoded to WebP). Light theme received a sweeping contrast audit: 163 → 3 outstanding contrast issues, with hero overlay neutralized, HUD widget themed, hero cover hidden in light, and the developer.js code-card now mirrors profile-config as a light editor pane.
